content: {"phoneNote":"The hero photo is a human hairbrush and comb on towels, so nothing in the first screen reads as a dog salon until the headline.","desktopNote":"The hero image is tall and strong, but the whole page is a thin left-aligned column with half the width empty in the prices, hours and location sections.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":2,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Replace the hairbrush/comb mood picture with a photo of a groomed dog or the salon table; the current image says hairdresser, not pasji salon.","On desktop fill the right half of the prices, hours and location sections (second photo, map, or a two-column layout) and tighten the dead band under the hero.","Shrink the giant footer wordmark on phone and desktop; it dwarfs the real hero headline and pushes the address and phone far down."],"blockers":[]}
